text: Crème fluide is whole cream left liquid: standardised to 30 % or more and heated. Lactic ferments are what make the thick kind (crème épaisse); thickness and fat are separate properties.

steps.note: The cream is pasteurised at this heat, or heated to 150 °C by ultra-high temperature, or sterilised at 115 °C without it.
